name: Villada
summary:
Villada invites you to explore its Plaza Mayor in an immersive way and discover the living memory of the municipality. This application, promoted by the Villada Town Council and developed by Irzón Ingenieros, digitizes the square and turns it into an interactive space where every corner has something to tell.

Explore at your own pace and tap the points of interest to:
- Compare “then and now” with historical photographs placed exactly where they were once taken.  
- Watch relevant videos about social life
